theme: Light theme (with High Contrast Navy/White and Red Accents)

fonts.usage: Headings (H1, H2, H3) and large typographic hero elements
Body, subtitles, small labels, UI elements

headings.H1: font-['Clash_Display'] text-5xl sm:text-7xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-bold text-[#0F172A] leading-[0.9]
headings.H2: font-['Clash_Display'] text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight uppercase font-semibold text-[#0F172A]
headings.H3: font-['Clash_Display'] text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight font-semibold text-[#0F172A]

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for pill buttons
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark sections
visual_enhancers.buttons: Red pill buttons (bg-[#E63946] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform) and Navy buttons (bg-[#0F172A] text-white)

grids_and_layouts.hero: Full height 100vh with kinetic masked line-by-line text reveal, overlapping 3D/parallax image elements
grids_and_layouts.bento: Asymmetrical tetris grid for Media Library (col-span-12 md:col-span-8, md:col-span-4 mix) with gap-6
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing: py-24 or py-32 for sections to allow breathing room

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Framer motion line-by-line text reveal on load (staggered). Wrap each line in an overflow-hidden div and animate y from 100% to 0.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration (mandatory for Awwwards feel).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero background and media images using Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Image scale-up on hover (scale 1.05) inside overflow-hidden container, pill buttons transform translate-y-[-2px] with shadow increase.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee for manifesto or club stats.

component_instructions.navbar: Sticky, glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#0F172A]/10, navy blue logo, red pill CTA, z-50.
component_instructions.hero: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level. Large kinetic typography 'AP PICKLEBALL CLUB' with masked reveal. Subtle parallax hero moment with pickleball court/action images. Numbered manifesto chapters (e.g., 01 THE COURT).
component_instructions.google_reviews: Static review cards with 5-star icons, user avatars, text. 'See more on Google' button in red pill style.
component_instructions.booking_section: 3 ways to book: Mobile App (with App Store/Play Store badges), Website, WhatsApp. Use a phone mockup image. Red pill buttons with navy headline. Side-by-side layout (text left, mockup right).
component_instructions.branches: Two branches (AP Club Thaltej Ahmedabad & AP Club Gandhinagar). Display mock address/directions. Clean card layout with 'Get Directions' buttons.
component_instructions.instagram_media: Curated static image grid combining @apclubthaltej and @apclubgandhinagar. Bento-style masonry or asymmetric grid with hover effects. Combine images and 'videos' (use play icon overlays on some images).
component_instructions.other_ventures: 'Bollywood Vibes' (Dome Party Venue) and 'TCD Cafe'. Side-by-side elegant cards or alternating full-width rows with high-quality images and elegant descriptions.
component_instructions.footer: Large footer with 'Let's Play' massive text, contact info, dark background (bg-[#0F172A]) with white text.

logo.description: AP Pickleball Club Logo provided by user (use in Nav and Footer)

hero_parallax.description: Pickleball athlete outdoors, used for hero parallax or intro

booking_mockup.description: User provided reference for 3 Ways to Book (use as content reference or mockup)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets minimum contrast ratios.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for all links and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='booking-whatsapp-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use HTML/Tailwind for this marketing page. Do not over-rely on Shadcn unless it's a specific interactive component like a dialog or carousel.
Import custom fonts in index.css as provided in the typography section.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root App level to give it the requested Awwwards feel.
Avoid generic centered layouts, use asymmetrical grids and wide padding (py-24, py-32).

Ensure the hero section features a 'signature on-load masked line-by-line reveal' of the main headline using Framer Motion (e.g., wrap text lines in overflow-hidden divs and translate Y from 100% to 0).
Include numbered manifesto chapters (e.g., 01 THE COURT, 02 THE COMMUNITY) in the layout.
Do not use transparent header without a backdrop-blur. Make the header sticky.
For the '3 Ways to Book' section, strictly follow the reference: red pill buttons, navy headline, and mobile mockup imagery.
NEVER use placeholder text for logos or images.
